scripts.test:hermetic: tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT; env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$tmp" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$tmp/config" TMPDIR="$tmp" TZ=UTC bun test tests/managed-adapters tests/cli-mcp
scripts.build: bun run build:adapters && bun run build:bins
scripts.build:adapters: bun build src/adapters/managed/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external e2b --external @daytona/sdk && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun scripts/fix-declaration-imports.ts && mkdir -p dist/adapters/managed && cp scripts/e2b-guest-broker-v1.py dist/adapters/managed/e2b-guest-broker-v1.py
scripts.build:bins: bun build src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist/cli --target bun --format esm --external e2b --external @daytona/sdk --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external commander && bun build src/mcp/index.ts --outdir dist/mcp --target bun --format esm --external e2b --external @daytona/sdk --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external commander && bun scripts/finalize-bins.ts
